verdict.rationale: Polar is a SaaS billing platform with SDKs, a CLI (`polar listen`), and a dashboard, so a telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry collection or any opt-out control. The usage-based billing and event-ingestion docs cover metering a merchant's own customers for billing, not tracking of the Polar user, so they do not count toward this story.
